answer: A bot can fake a name in a second; it cannot fake a decade of being known. Tax filing history with revenue authority attestation is that decade, written as annual filings logged for a decade by the revenue authority. The pigment of the gate is the paper trail — every entry stamped by someone else, at a time no one here controlled. A farm needs a hundred such trails, and the karst in each trail is a different office, a different clerk, a different year. The yarrow that ends the check is the verifier asking one office one question.
